questions: Can students with backlogs sit for placements?
क्या बैकलॉग वाले छात्र प्लेसमेंट में बैठ सकते हैं?
answer: Company and college eligibility rules differ. Check each placement notice for active-backlog, history-of-backlog, and CGPA conditions.
answer_en: Company and college eligibility rules differ. Check each placement notice for active-backlog, history-of-backlog, and CGPA conditions.

questions: I received a placement offer. What should I check?
मुझे प्लेसमेंट ऑफर मिला है, क्या जाँचूँ?
answer: Review the role, location, compensation structure, bond or service agreement, joining conditions, and official offer letter. Ask the placement cell about unclear terms.
answer_en: Review the role, location, compensation structure, bond or service agreement, joining conditions, and official offer letter. Ask the placement cell about unclear terms.

questions: Do I need an NOC for an off-campus internship?
ऑफ-कैंपस इंटर्नशिप के लिए NOC चाहिए?

questions: Where can I find verified placement statistics?
answer: Use the latest official placement report and check its batch year, number of eligible students, placed students, median package, and methodology.

questions: Whom should I contact for an emergency on campus?
कैंपस में इमरजेंसी होने पर किससे संपर्क करूँ?

questions: Where can I get first aid on campus?
कैंपस में फर्स्ट एड कहाँ मिलेगा?

answer_en: Ask reception, campus security, or the medical room for first-aid support and operating hours.

questions: Can I make a confidential complaint?

questions: I am worried about paying my college fees. Where can I seek help?
कॉलेज फीस भरने को लेकर परेशानी है, मदद कहाँ मिलेगी?

दूसरे छात्र से विवाद है, क्या करूँ?

questions: Which documents are usually needed for scholarships?
स्कॉलरशिप के लिए आमतौर पर कौन-से दस्तावेज़ चाहिए?

questions: My scholarship application was rejected. What can I do?
मेरी स्कॉलरशिप एप्लीकेशन रिजेक्ट हो गई, क्या करूँ?
